email.subject: Transport request - ref 26-1187 - Québec to Toronto
email.body:
Bonjour,

We would like to request a truck for the following shipment on behalf of Laiterie du Saint-Laurent inc.

Reference: 26-1187
Pickup: Laiterie du Saint-Laurent inc., 1250 rue des Entrepreneurs, Québec QC G1P 4A7, Wednesday, November 18, between 13:00 and 16:00
Delivery: GreenValley Wholesale, 90 Carlingview Dr, Toronto ON M9W 5E7, Thursday, November 19, from 06:00

Cargo: 14 pallets of packaged cheese, total weight 6,240 kg. Refrigerated trailer required, maintain +4 C.

Please confirm availability and your rate.

Best regards,
Sophie Gagnon
Logistics Coordinator
Laiterie du Saint-Laurent inc.
